fixed.summary: A fraction translate class (`-translate-x-1/2`, `translate-y-full`) moves the element by its own box's size at paint, as in Tailwind; it moved nothing, so an element centred with `left-1/2 top-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2` sat with its top left corner on the point. It animates with the rest of the transform.
